name: chai-persistent-analyze-statistics-and-cost-96ad
instr:
Add persistent, transactionally consistent ANALYZE statistics so Chai can choose selective scans using the data visible to the executing transaction. Range measurements must follow each session's visibility model, while committed relation statistics remain durable and isolated from uncommitted work. Existing planning, session restrictions, and result lifecycles must remain unchanged when usable statistics are absent.

Every Session from the PebbleEngine returned by kv.NewEngine reports exact visible key and encoded-byte totals for Iterator's half-open bounds, including empty ranges; BatchSession, SnapshotSession, and TransientSession each measure their own established view without changing write or lifetime restrictions. ANALYZE, ANALYZE table_name, and ANALYZE index_name gather one transaction-visible generation for exactly the targeted writable tables and indexes, including empty and composite-key namespaces, while malformed, trailing, or unknown syntax fails deterministically. Statistics generations publish atomically on commit, remain invisible on rollback or partial failure, survive reopening, and cannot be reused after their relation is dropped. Successful relation mutations transactionally stale only affected statistics, with rollback restoring the preceding committed freshness.
